[Return to M2](../index.qmd)

Phase 01 set the work boundaries, added generic rebuild mechanisms in stamp,
and exercised the boundary between stamp and pipdata's minimal engine.

| Record | Role in Phase 01 |
|---|---|
| [Step 01: Contracts and work orders](step-01-contracts-and-work-orders.qmd) | Prerequisite for the two features below; not a separate roadmap feature. |
| [Step 02: Generic stamp](step-02-generic-stamp.qmd) | `close-stamp-gaps-for-skeleton` |
| [Step 03: pipdata engine](step-03-pipdata-engine.qmd) | `create-engine-skeleton`; pipload adapter support is part of this feature. |

The [October 10 M2 plan](../../../.cg-docs/plans/2026-10-10-m2-walking-skeleton.md)
defines Phase 01 in lines 252-289. The [roadmap](../../../roadmap.json) lists the
two features as `done` and M2 as `in-progress` (lines 43-49). Both references
are at pipsystem `dcfd90671a25fd048162aead88e4674d3ec90e10`.
The step records distinguish documentary checks, historical fixture results,
package integration, and live testing. For later work, see the M2 index.
